subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and providers

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose this opt-in readiness configuration and Plugin SDK criterion API as a supported core contract?
rationale: This is a feature-direction choice with lasting configuration, protocol, CLI, and external plugin compatibility obligations; code review cannot determine whether that public surface belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in readiness contract
options.body: Approve the configuration, Gateway RPC, CLI, and Plugin SDK surfaces as supported APIs, then require a current-main rebase and refreshed upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the core scope
options.body: Keep a smaller core readiness projection and defer plugin registration or operator-selected criteria until the Plugin SDK contract has separate approval.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR if the hosting-readiness product direction is not currently a core priority, leaving the RFC and downstream experimentation as the design record.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in readiness contract
recommendation.body: Approve the configuration, Gateway RPC, CLI, and Plugin SDK surfaces as supported APIs, then require a current-main rebase and refreshed upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Available repository policy ownership is the closest evidence-backed routing signal for a core product and Plugin SDK contract decision.
